speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two houses. I keep one in each and live in neither.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. I live here. I said so. Hold to it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She had it picked before I had the wit. I still don't know whose, and I am not asking on the road.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixteen shillings, and a back, and six in the morning. …Enough.
